51:t_1:175.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, that's right. Everyone in $c, my comrades.」

51:t_1:177.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Nice. All the girls here are so healthy-looking.」

51:t_1:178.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Let's definitely enjoy some cultural exchange here.」

51:t_1:179.en:
$$メルティ$$
「Hot guys! And tons of super hot ones!」

51:t_1:181.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「I'm sorry. $$メルティ$$... is all excited because her wish came true.」

51:t_1:182.en:
$$アルト$$
「I don't really get it, but good for her...」

51:t_1:183.en:
$$メルティ$$
「You're staying here for a while, right? Then I'll show you around the fleet, not $$ガロード$$.」

51:t_1:184.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$メルティ$$... Shouldn't you be doing your 《$$メッセンジャー$$》 work?」

51:t_1:185.en:
$$メルティ$$
「I finished that ages ago.」

51:t_1:186.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Huh... Come to think of it, where's $$エイミー$$?」

51:t_1:187.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「$$エイミー$$ went to see the treasure $$ベローズ$$ pulled up.」

51:t_1:189.en:
$$マオ$$
「Any way you look at it, that's a weapon. And it's still in working condition, to boot.」

51:t_1:190.en:
$$スズネ$$
「In that case, wouldn't it have been better for $c to look into it?」

51:t_1:191.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$ルカ$$, $$サックス$$, $$鉄っつぁん$$ and I all said the same thing, but...」

51:t_1:192.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Can't be helped. That $$ピニオン$$ guy says he won't let us lay a single finger on this thing.」

51:t_1:193.en:
$$マオ$$
「He'll give up sooner or later. After that, it's our turn.」

51:t_1:194.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Still, something's been noisy for a while now.」

51:t_1:195.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't tell me... pirates or the $$サイデリアル$$ showed up?」

51:t_1:197.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$ガロード$$, is that you?! We've got a problem!」

51:t_1:198.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Someone was inside that treasure! They took $$エイミー$$, who'd come to look at it, hostage and ran off!」

51:t_1:200.en:
$$ティファ$$
「$$ガロード$$! Look at that!」

51:t_1:201.en:
$$レド$$
[What is going on with the structure of this block...?!]

51:t_1:202.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You...! You! Let go of me!」

51:t_1:203.en:
$$レド$$
[Damn...! How did it come to this...?!]

51:t_1:204.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I cannot find any logic in your actions.]

51:t_1:205.en:
$$レド$$
[It was my mistake to be seen after leaving the unit. If I take a hostage, the people here won't attack, at least for now...!]

51:t_1:206.en:
$$レド$$
[But this hostage... is awfully noisy. On top of that, I can barely understand the language being spoken.]

51:t_1:207.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The preceding statement was a reference to reproduction with one's mother and to sacred excrement.]

51:t_1:208.en:
$$レド$$
[I knew it, they're not decent people! This is why I hate drifting tribes...!]

51:t_1:209.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Skeptical proposal. This group cannot be conclusively identified as a drifting tribe.]

51:t_1:211.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[In all the imagery collected so far, there is no sign at all of facilities or provisions concerning gravity changes, radiation, or airtightness.]

51:t_1:212.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[This facility is inferred to have been designed in an environment entirely unrelated to vacuum or zero gravity.]

51:t_1:214.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Agreed. However, there is one case that could be an exception, in the records...]

51:t_1:216.en:
$n
「Drop your weapon and release the hostage!」

51:t_1:219.en:
$$かなめ$$
「'All right'?! It is not all right, $n! They got away so easily!」

51:t_1:221.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh...? But... we've already lost sight of them...」

51:t_1:222.en:
$$宗介$$
「On orders from $n and $$ガロード$$, I have already stationed personnel at the intruder's destination.」

51:t_1:223.en:
$n
「They show no intent to attack. If we exploit their habit of fleeing from us, we can control their escape route.」

51:t_1:224.en:
$$宗介$$
「Now the intruder is trapped like a rat. All that's left is...」

51:t_1:232.en:
$$レド$$
[What is this...? Where on earth is this place...?]

51:t_1:237.en:
$$レド$$
[I'm hit...! And on top of that, the hostage got away!]

51:t_1:238.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Based on Ensign $$レド$$'s vital signs, the wound is judged to be minor. Please consider your next course of action.]

51:t_1:241.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I only grazed you earlier, but make one wrong move and I'll incapacitate you.」

51:t_1:245.en:
$$レド$$
[If I could convey my intentions to these people, I could show that I mean no harm...]

51:t_1:246.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Their basic linguistic structure is shared with the newly allied friendly force. Smooth communication will soon be possible.]

51:t_1:247.en:
$$レド$$
[Before that, I will confirm the situation. What on earth is this place?]

51:t_1:248.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is inferred that you and this unit are on the surface of a planet with a breathable atmosphere.]

51:t_1:250.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Cross-referencing observable celestial bodies...]

51:t_1:251.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Confirmed. Only one matching entry.]

51:t_1:252.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[The third planet of the Solar System: Earth.]

51:t_1:254.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[It is the birthplace of humankind, whose existence has until now been suggested only in records.]

51:t_1:255.en:
$$レド$$
[So we are... on that Earth...]

51:t_1:256.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Warning. A group of units is approaching from the surroundings.]

51:t_1:257.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[Identification signals indicate $$サイデリアル$$.]

鉄っつぁん.evidence: Nickname in 51:t_1:191 (Mao listing Luca, Sachs and 'Tetsu-tsuan' who all advised the same); almost certainly the mechanic Tetsuo Atsui (glossary: 厚井鉄男 = Tetsuo Atsui) alongside mechanics Luca and Sachs, but not confirmed; orchestrator may remap to that token.

kept_omissions: 51:t_1:176: Alto's 'Nice to meet you' (よろしくな) is a greeting to the Gargantia people (no direction issue)
51:t_1:182: 'good for her' - the referent of そいつ (Melty's wish coming true) inferred from Saaya's line
51:t_1:225/226: Sousuke/Michel/Kurz split one sentence; Michel's object 'That's for us...' and Kurz's 'Leave it to the Snipe-Ups' kept as fragments like the Japanese
51:t_1:214: Chamber's unfinished sentence kept unfinished ('in the records...')
uncertain: Brackets: the checker rejects 【】 so Ledo/Chamber thought/cockpit lines are written with ASCII [ ] (same as dlg_2008_00 / 2008_03).
51:t_1:191 鉄っつぁん: proposed new name 'Tetsu' (see names); likely Tetsuo Atsui, unconfirmed.
51:t_1:226 スナンパーズ (sniper + nanpa 'pick-up' pun, Kurz and Michel's self-styled duo): rendered 'the Snipe-Ups'; no official English known.
51:t_1:194 パーラ speaker has a male-sounding line (騒がしいな); kept as Paula per the brief, written neutrally.
51:t_1:198 / 219 / 220 / 223 / 224: the kidnapper (Ledo) is unknown to the speakers, so gender-neutral 'they' / 'the intruder' used.
51:t_1:208/209 漂流部族 = 'drifting tribe(s)'; no settled rendering found.
51:t_1:207 Chamber's translation of Amy's insults kept literal and dry.
Chamber speaker token: $$チェインバー#pilot$$ throughout (as sibling slices); vocative in 51:t_1:210 uses the same token.
51:t_1:195 サイデリアル/ 257 written as $$サイデリアル$$ token though there is no 《》 link (as in dlg_2007_03); 海賊 written as plain 'pirates'.
51:t_1:184 Tiffa's いいの rendered 'Shouldn't you be doing your messenger work?' (Melty replies she finished already).
51:t_1:216/218/219/220/222/223/243 $n is the player-named protagonist; 222 has Sousuke cite 'orders from $n and Garrod'.
51:t_1:230 caption: '~ Gargantia Fleet Deck ~' with the fleet token.
